notes: Each side has three sequential runs; summaries are medians of per-run metrics, not pooled percentiles.
Mock upstream waits 10 ms before text and 10 ms before completion; request logging is disabled.
Loopback fixture uses real TCP, but mock upstream closes each connection; these runs do not measure upstream connection reuse.
CPU and peak RSS cover router plus mock upstream and client in one process. Peak RSS is cumulative within each run.
This measures client receipt of a complete nonempty text delta, not Codex renderer paint or real-provider TTFT.

focused_anthropic_64.notes: Ten additional paired runs, Anthropic SSE concurrency 64, to investigate initial small TTFT increase.
